.claude/docs/commands.md: - Fonts missing in headless tests → `system-fonts` feature / fontconfig installed; stand checks need neither — they boot with the bundled DejaVu Sans (`seven_guis::stand::options`)

.claude/rules/security.md: - 2026-10-15: A listener or env read that only a test makes — served by no binary, reached by no caller — is no crossing and not the founder's call, yet it is registered as test-only in arch §Occupied Resources and the security plan's environment values before it lands, as `PAINT_TREE_BENCH_HTML` and `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR` are (the operator's answer, 2026-10-15).

.claude/rules/testing.md: - 2026-10-19: Code compiled only off unix is unverified on this linux host until a non-unix build reads it — after adding or moving a `#[cfg(unix)]` gate (a file-wide `#![cfg(unix)]` split into per-item gates included), run `cargo check --tests --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p {crate}` before pushing: a helper left calling a gated item compiles here and breaks only the windows job, and `cfg_attr(…, allow(dead_code))` cannot excuse a call to an item configured out.
.claude/rules/verification-harness.md: - 2026-10-06: A boot smoke bounded by `timeout N` exits 124 when the stand stays up, but the Andromeda gate tool reads any entry exit 124 or 137 as its own bound firing (`timeout`), so `expect = ['exit 124']` never reads green — author the entry so its own exit is 0 on the stay-up case, or drive it by hand and record its exit and atoms under the chunk's `evidence/`.

.claude/rules/observability.md: - 2026-10-06: With the workspace's tracing 0.1.44, `tracing::error!(target: "…", a.b = x, "msg")` does not parse dotted field names (local macro ambiguity) and rejects string-literal keys — write `tracing::event!(target: "…", tracing::Level::ERROR, { a.b = x }, "msg")`.
